name: Kallista Nightstalker
portraitDescription: Humanoids with infernal heritage, featuring horns, thick tails, and skin in shades of red, purple, or blue. Wearing practical plate or scale armor, carrying a variety of weapons, looking disciplined and battle-ready. The character is exceptionally attractive and a pleasure to look at, with elegant features. Key features: horns, thick tail, pointed teeth, glowing eyes.
